values.message: Happy birthday! Tap around — there is more in here than you would think.

Sixty, and you still beat all of us up the hill to the temple.

Thank you for the early mornings, the terrible jokes, and every single school run. Happy birthday.

Eighteen! You are officially allowed to make your own terrible decisions now.

We are so proud of you. Go and have the best night.

values.message: Happy birthday to the only person who still replies to my voice notes. Same time next year?
Seven whole years of you! Here are some of our favourite days so far. Tap through them all.

values.message:
I wanted to write something short, and then I started remembering things.

The summer you taught yourself to swim because nobody else had the time. The year you moved cities and still called every Sunday. The way you save the last piece of cake for whoever looks like they need it most.

You make every room easier to be in. I hope this year is as kind to you as you are to everyone else in it. Eat the cake, open everything, and let somebody else do the dishes for once.

Happy birthday. I am so glad you were born, and so lucky that you are mine to annoy for one more whole year. Call me later?
